questions.prompt: The higher mountains were covered with deeper snow.
questions.answer: Montēs altiōrēs nive profundiōre operiēbantur.

questions.prompt: The bravest soldiers crossed the widest river without fear.
questions.answer: Fortissimī mīlitēs flūmen lātissimum sine timōre trānsmīsērunt.

questions.prompt: This road is easier than that one, but the shortest is the most dangerous.
questions.answer: Haec via facilior est quam illa, sed brevissima perīculōsissima est.

questions.prompt: The king gave the best gifts to the most faithful friends.
questions.answer: Rēx optima dōna amīcīs fidēlissimīs dedit.

questions.prompt: A greater army came, but our soldiers were braver.
questions.answer: Māior exercitus vēnit, sed nostrī mīlitēs fortiōrēs erant.

questions.prompt: The wisest philosopher wrote many very useful books.
questions.answer: Sapientissimus philosophus multōs librōs ūtilissimōs scrīpsit.

questions.prompt: Worse storms threaten sailors on the deeper sea.
questions.answer: Pēiōrēs tempestātēs nautās in marī profundiōre minantur.

questions.prompt: Fewer citizens attended, though the speech was more important.
questions.answer: Pauciōrēs cīvēs adfuērunt, quamquam ōrātiō gravior erat.

questions.prompt: The smallest boy carried a very heavy burden.
questions.answer: Minimus puer onus gravissimum portāvit.

questions.prompt: More gold was found in the higher regions of the kingdom.
questions.answer: Plūs aurī in altiōribus regnī partibus inventum est.

questions.prompt: The oldest temple was more sacred than all the newer buildings.
questions.answer: Antīquissimum templum sānctius erat quam omnia aedificia noviōra.

questions.prompt: A sharper sword is more useful than a longer spear in battle.
questions.answer: Gladius acūtior in proeliō ūtilior est quam hasta longior.

questions.prompt: This wine is sweeter, but that older one is far better.
questions.answer: Hoc vīnum dulcius est, sed illud vetustius multō melius est.

questions.prompt: The most learned teacher explained the most difficult matters.
questions.answer: Doctissimus magister difficillimās rēs explicāvit.

questions.prompt: The braver general led fewer troops against a stronger enemy.
questions.answer: Fortior dux pauciōrēs cōpiās contrā hostem validiōrem dūxit.

questions.prompt: Greater dangers await those who seek greater glory.
questions.answer: Māiōra perīcula eōs manent quī māiōrem glōriam petunt.

questions.prompt: The most cruel tyrant feared the most honest citizen.
questions.answer: Crūdēlissimus tyrannus honestissimum cīvem timēbat.

questions.prompt: Nothing is more pleasant than a quieter life in the fields.
questions.answer: Nihil iūcundius est quam vīta quiētior in agrīs.

questions.prompt: The swiftest horse won a very easy victory.
questions.answer: Equus celerrimus victōriam facillimam reportāvit.

questions.prompt: A more grievous wound made the strongest warrior weaker.
questions.answer: Gravius vulnus fortissimum bellātōrem īnfirmiōrem fēcit.

questions.prompt: The most famous poets often praised the humblest farmers.
questions.answer: Clārissimī poētae saepe humillimōs agricolās laudābant.

questions.prompt: Better counsel comes from an older and more prudent friend.
questions.answer: Melius cōnsilium ab amīcō seniōre et prūdentiōre venit.

questions.prompt: The physician's remedy was more effective than the herbs of the field.
questions.answer: Remedium medicī efficācius erat quam herbae agrī.

questions.prompt: The wisest teacher taught the most difficult things with great patience.
questions.answer: Sapientissimus magister difficillima magnā patientiā docēbat.

questions.prompt: A better friend gives more, but the worst friend seizes everything.
questions.answer: Melior amīcus plūra dat, sed pessimus amīcus omnia rapit.

questions.prompt: The more beautiful garden was tended by a very poor farmer.
questions.answer: Pulchrior hortus ab agricolā pauperrimō colēbātur.

questions.prompt: The mushrooms gnawed by mice were smaller than the rest.
questions.answer: Bōlētī ā mūribus rōsī minōrēs quam cēterī erant.

questions.prompt: A greater scarcity of grain made the citizens more anxious.
questions.answer: Māior frūmentī inopia cīvēs sollicitiōrēs fēcit.

questions.prompt: The most secret plan was disclosed by a very faithful attendant.
questions.answer: Sēcrētissimum cōnsilium ā fidēlissimō ministrō ēnūntiātum est.

questions.prompt: This road is easier than that one, but the shortest is the safest.
questions.answer: Haec via facilior est quam illa, sed brevissima tūtissima est.

questions.prompt: The bolder merchants were seeking a more distant shore.
questions.answer: Audāciōrēs mercātōrēs remōtius lītus petēbant.

questions.prompt: The king's palace was larger than all the temples of the city.
questions.answer: Rēgia rēgis omnibus urbis templīs māior erat.

questions.prompt: A more prudent leader avoids the most savage battles.
questions.answer: Prūdentior dux saevissima proelia vītat.

questions.prompt: The poet's newer songs were sweeter than the old ones.
questions.answer: Poētae recentiōra carmina veteribus dulciōra erant.

questions.prompt: The higher tower offered a broader view of the sea.
questions.answer: Altior turris lātiōrem maris prōspectum praebēbat.

questions.prompt: The most learned physician chose the gentlest remedies.
questions.answer: Doctissimus medicus lēnissima remedia dēlēgit.

questions.prompt: Nothing is dearer to me than a more loyal companion.
questions.answer: Nihil mihi cārius est quam fidēlior comes.

questions.prompt: The bravest woman endured the most bitter losses with a calm mind.
questions.answer: Fortissima fēmina acerbissima damna aequō animō tulit.

questions.prompt: A longer winter brought greater scarcity to the poorer villages.
questions.answer: Longior hiems māiōrem inopiam pauperiōribus vīcīs attulit.

questions.prompt: The best generals fear the smallest mistakes.
questions.answer: Optimī ducēs minima errāta timent.

questions.prompt: More books were read, though the nights were shorter.
questions.answer: Plūrēs librī lēctī sunt, quamquam noctēs breviōrēs erant.

questions.prompt: The wisest philosopher taught that the shortest life is often the sweetest.
questions.answer: Sapientissimus philosophus docuit vītam brevissimam saepe dulcissimam esse.

questions.prompt: A more honorable death is better than a longer slavery.
questions.answer: Mors honestior melior est quam servitūs longior.

questions.prompt: The bees carry the sweetest thyme to their broadest hives.
questions.answer: Apēs dulcissimum thymum ad amplissima alveāria portant.

questions.prompt: Nothing is more foul than an adultery concealed by the boldest lies.
questions.answer: Nihil foedius est quam adulterium mendāciīs audācissimīs occultātum.
